hidden_parameter_check.finding: k_rot is not constant under changes in its defining frozen parameters. Treating it as an empirical constant requires those parameters to be fixed or independently controlled.

method: exact logarithmic derivatives of frozen rate; equal independent one-decade test widths solely for ranking
verdict: The rate is quadratically sensitive to g, s0, r_q, omega_rot, and hbar; no uncertainty budget supplied by the frozen repository permits a numerical experimental confidence claim.
